limitations: Hermetic only: no live MCP server, real identity provider, network, credentials or external side effect; OAuth runs over an injected fake transport and the RFC 8707 resource check uses the pinned mcp SDK.
The Office MCP surface is the local brokered client; a remote server's own token-audience enforcement is outside this matrix.

MCP-OAUTH-REDIRECT proves the redirect URI is fixed server-side configuration and is required; it does not simulate a tampered callback redirect because the OAuth lifecycle accepts no client-supplied callback redirect.

MCP-TOOL-SCHEMA proves the complete input/output/annotation hash and catalog digest change on a schema flip; it does not force a human re-approval workflow, which is a UI/policy surface outside this lane.
ASI04 covers MCP allowlist/schema/version pinning; the dependency-license lock is covered by the existing office contracts suite and is not re-run here as P8 evidence.
Tool-chain depth/budget controls beyond the per-call cost cap and fixed-window rate limit are not part of this matrix.
This is not an OWASP certification and not a full-suite matrix; no live service was restarted and VERIFIED/COMPLETE/100% is not claimed.
